embeds.title: BLHA WINTER MEETINGS
embeds.description: The yearly owners' meeting, held in the Offseason before the amendment window opens.

fields.name: WHEN
fields.value: **`[TIMESTAMP]`** • RSVP on the Sesh event in **league-calendar**

fields.name: WHERE
fields.value: `[VOICE CHANNEL]`

fields.name: AGENDA
fields.value: Season review • Ideas from **league-suggestions** that could become amendment proposals (Article XX) • Draft and calendar dates • Open floor

fields.name: CAN'T MAKE IT
fields.value: Notes are posted in **gm-lounge** afterward. Nothing is decided at the meeting itself: rule changes still go through a written proposal and a vote.

embeds.title: ADD THE LEAGUE CALENDAR TO YOUR PHONE
embeds.description: Every BLHA date can live in the calendar you already use.

fields.name: HOW
fields.value: Type `/link` in any channel. Sesh replies privately with a calendar feed link.

fields.name: THEN
fields.value: Add that link to Google Calendar (Other calendars → From URL), Apple Calendar (File → New Calendar Subscription) or Outlook (Add calendar → From internet).

fields.name: WHAT YOU GET
fields.value: Draft night, deadlines and owners' meetings appear on your phone and update on their own when a date changes.
